issue.title: Handle empty point values in DiskUsage API

labels.name: :Search/Search
labels.description: Search-related issues that do not fall into other categories

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
The DiskUsage API can hit NPE if the FieldInfos of points or doc-values fields are still in segments; but the associated documents are gone.

Closes #87761

body: @ryanmorrisonlytics Thank you for reporting the issue. I've opened a fix for this in https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/87826.
